extensions.summary: A local, human, organic-first design system for property valuation requests in Monza and Brianza, with a future lightweight admin surface for lead operations.

brand-orange.usage: Primary CTA, selected states, and moments that must feel actionable.

brand-rust.usage: Hover states, deep gradients, and stronger brand emphasis.

consultative-blue.usage: Headings, trust details, FAQ open states, and advisor-like emphasis.

surface.usage: Primary indexed-page background and quiet content surfaces.

ink.usage: Dark shell, footer, and high-contrast text.

motion.default: Subtle, fast, and never required to understand or complete the form.
motion.reducedMotion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; conversion flow must not depend on animation.

componentNotes.primaryButton: Pill CTA, minimum 52px height, orange or rust/orange gradient, white text.
componentNotes.formField: Visible label, soft filled background, 48px minimum height, strong focus ring.
componentNotes.localValuationPath: Signature process component: property context, contact details, advisor follow-up, on-site valuation.
componentNotes.seoPage: Readable local content pages with clear headings, internal links, and conversion proximity.
componentNotes.adminSurface: Quiet internal UI for lead lists, filters, statuses, notes, and approved Google-login access.
componentNotes.futureLogo: Explore a local, one-color-capable mark. Avoid roof icons, generic house outlines, and luxury monograms.

rules: Text on tinted surfaces must remain comfortably readable.
Organic SEO is the primary acquisition strategy.
SEO content must answer real local questions.
Admin screens should be dense, legible, and task-oriented.
Do not make the service feel like an instant automatic-estimate portal.
